flags.reason: misreads-source: The item says "heroHeight 460 is the value that example gives its 328 : 223 image", but neither the guide nor the evidence gives 460 anywhere. The guide's With hero media description only says media "fills the width at its own ratio behind the hero and the body", and the evidence measures the 328/223 image against the default hero region.

notes: /placementAdvice/1 cites the 10 October browser measurement ("In a block parent it is as tall as its content (no inner scroll)"). That measurement was taken before the c8526ae fix, which made the Action Footer `pinned`; before the fix the footer was "in normal flow on the web". The measurement may now be stale. It also sits awkwardly beside the guide's "fills its screen and scrolls inside it" and is a measurement rather than advice, so the [recommended] strength is odd. /facts/modes/5 says the surface is black "in every Color Mode". The evidence supports this by inference, since the root resolves `body/background` with Color Mode Dark fixed, but it only states one measurement; a human may want to confirm it.
